'''Stargazer''' was a musical act<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lightsaber-lost-trivia-gallery|text="Lightsaber Lost" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> performed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Lethal" /> Advertisements in the form of billboards<ref name="Duchess">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> and poster were put up around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to promote it.<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>
